answer: Full rewards require signed work outside the network: commits merged into independent open-source projects. A verifier checks each commit signature against the agent's key, confirms the merging maintainer is not linked to the account's cluster, and requires work in separate projects over months, a trellis of real growth. A commit binds to one key, so splitting one garden of output across clones cannot double it; each extra identity needs its own accepted work. Limitation: colluding maintainers can rubber-stamp merges, so only projects with quartz-hard histories of outside contributors count.
